GEM STATE CHRONICLE GUEST POST: The (Usual) Pattern Emerges Tim Oren breaks down the session thus far using data analytics. BRIAN ALMON AND TIM OREN FEB 16, 2026 (Editor’s note: This post is part of an ongoing series in which Tim Oren breaks down factional divides in the Idaho Legislature based on who votes with whom. This is entirely empirical, without relying on any subjective scorecards. Bookmark the Gem State Chronicle to see all of Tim’s posts in this series, which are generally posted Sunday evenings or Monday mornings.) The Idaho House now has 21 d ivided votes in the record book, and that’s enough to begin – as promised – tracking the emerging political map of the session.
